annotation.title_clean: Kemenko PMK Inisiasi Satgas Strategi Nasional AI Terintegrasi
annotation.title_en: Coordinating Ministry for Human Development and Culture Initiates Task Force on Integrated National AI Strategy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan (Kemenko PMK)
annotation.summary_en: Government news item on a 29 April 2025 ministerial meeting chaired by Indonesia's Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture, agreeing to draft an integrated national strategy for AI education and human-resource development and form a national task force, emphasising AI literacy and AI sovereignty.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministerial meeting agreed to formulate an Integrated National Strategy for AI Education and HR Development
A National Task Force involving multiple ministries will be formed
Three-layer action: AI-wise citizens, AI developers/AI-preneurs, supportive ecosystem
Calls for Indonesian AI sovereignty and AI aligned with Indonesian data, ideology and culture
Stresses AI is not neutral and can be a defence and ideological instrument
